name: Walk
overview: The biblical concept of 'walk' symbolizes a believer's daily conduct and relationship with God, exemplified by Enoch and Noah who 'walked with God,' demonstrating intimate fellowship and righteousness (Genesis 5:24; 6:9). Scripture contrasts this godly walk with the ungodly paths to avoid, urging believers to seek and follow the 'old paths' of truth and rest for the soul (Psalms 1:1; Jeremiah 6:16). Trusting in the Lord rather than one's own understanding provides guidance, as God’s Word serves as a lamp illuminating the believer’s path (Proverbs 3:5; Psalms 119:105).
